Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Nadab_1: son of Aaron (Exodus 6:23), died for offering strange fire to the LORD (Numbers 3:4)
Abihu_1: son of Aaron (Exodus 6:23), died for offering strange fire to the LORD (Numbers 3:4)
Joshua_1: 1 of the 12 spies (called Hoshea)- from Ephraim (Numbers 13:8), servant of Moses (Exodus 17:9)
Hur_1: supported Moses' hands during the battle against Amalek at Rephidim (Exodus 17:10-12)
